note: Starting vault for Outabout, a fictional what’s-on guide for Tallowmere (an invented city), used as a test brand. Every item is invented: no real company, person, place, venue or figure. The numbers are round and illustrative only. Imported once on an empty database; edit or delete in the app afterwards.

vault.title: Plans each week
vault.body: Outabout lists 10 plans in Tallowmere every week (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Readers
vault.body: 20,000 people read the weekly list (illustrative figure).

vault.title: What Outabout is
vault.body: Outabout is a what’s-on guide for Tallowmere: each Monday it posts the week’s plans, then a listing for each event, with when, where and how to book.

vault.title: How plans are chosen
vault.body: A plan makes the list when it is open to anyone, has a date and a place, and costs little or nothing. Paid listings are always marked.

vault.title: Sunday social ride
vault.body: A slow, flat social ride round the quay on four-seat bikes, Sundays at 10am from the harbour steps.

vault.title: Night market
vault.body: The night market at the Old Ropeworks, Saturdays from 5pm to 11pm. Free entry.

vault.title: Bakery tasting morning
vault.body: Six breads and three pastries with the bakers at the quay bakery. Seats £8 (illustrative price).

vault.title: Now hiring
vault.body: Outabout is hiring a growth and partnerships intern to start in January.

vault.title: Planned features (internal)
vault.body: An example of an internal note: plans that are not public yet. The tag not-for-posts tells reviewers to keep it out of posts.
